readout_other: Eriksen flanker task (accuracy, RT); stimulus-locked N2 and ERN; drift-diffusion modelling
direction_notes: aMCC-TUS and PCC-TUS both raised accuracy early in the task (about 17-27 min after TUS); aMCC-TUS reduced the incongruence effect on N2; no effect on ERN or reaction time.
safety_notes: Post-session simulations showed temperature below 38 C and CEM43 below 0.002 in the brain; no participant-reported adverse events described.

timing.protocol_description: 5 Hz rTUS protocol: pulse length 20 ms (plus 10 ms Tukey ramping), pulse repetition period 200 ms, total duration 120 s, delivered once per session before the EEG flanker task (about 17 min later); sham was the same protocol for 2 s over aMCC.
